correctness.rationale: Two independently implemented enumerators recover exactly 681 and 687 augmented faces. Exhaustive full face-poset matching acyclicity leaves CW critical counts \( (1,0,1,6,4) \) and \( (1,0,1,6,6) \). An exact integer elimination finds signed boundary ranks \( (15,75,145,88,12) \) and \( (15,75,145,90,12) \), and only unit Smith invariants, giving integral \(H_3\cong\mathbb Z^5\) and \(H_4\cong\mathbb Z^4\) or \(\mathbb Z^6\), with \(H_2=0\). The unique 2-cell has primitive 3-cell attaching vector, so the 3-skeleton is wedge five 3-spheres; cellular \(\partial_4=0\) and Hurewicz make 4-cell attachments null. Checker and recorded output are embedded. Finite proof has no larger-parameter extrapolation.

value.rationale: Among subdivisions of the canonical biclique \(K_{2,3}\), seven vertices give exactly two nonisomorphic theta arm-length patterns, versus only one at six vertices. The classification covers this entire natural first ambiguous order, and its top integral Betti numbers distinguish graphs with identical vertex/edge counts, degree multiset, and cycle rank. This provides a motivated first branching-sensitive finite homotopy benchmark instead of an arbitrarily selected graph, with no unsupported claim about infinite families.
